text:
anya: Nightly bench job (03:00) failed again, hanging on cleanup step. CI shows 'bench-harness: stuck waiting for process 3221'. Anyone picking this up?
ci-bot: Job failed: <https://ci.redwood.com/job/nightly-bench/1760894321|nightly-bench/1760894321> — exit: HANG. Artifacts archived.
sam: On it. Is this the run that started pulling the new quantized-8 model?
anya: Yep — model-refresh finished at 02:40 and pushed model:v2-quant08 to staging pools.
leila: I saw a similar hang last Friday; harness leaked fds when using shared mmap. Could be related.
mike: Can someone paste the failing tail of the log? I only see repeated flush messages in the dashboard.
anya: Log snippet: 
```
2026-03-18T03:07:12Z bench-harness INFO starting cleanup
2026-03-18T03:07:12Z bench-harness DEBUG flush_kv_cache: entering
2026-03-18T03:07:12Z bench-harness DEBUG flush_kv_cache: queued 128 items
2026-03-18T03:07:25Z bench-harness WARN waiting for child to exit (pid=3221)
2026-03-18T03:09:00Z bench-harness DEBUG flush_kv_cache: blocked on mmap_unmap
2026-03-18T03:12:00Z bench-harness ERROR timeout waiting for cleanup, aborting
```
sam: Repro steps I used locally: run harness with small dataset + v2-quant08 image, I see the same hang. Suspect race between KV eviction and process exit.
deploy-bot: Note: v2-quant08 was rolled back from canary to stable at 03:10 due to mismatch on a metrics job, but bench nodes pull canary images until cron config is pinned.
leila: Can you try forcing KV_SHARED off? `--disable-kv-shared` or env KV_SHARED=0. If that passes it's the shared KV path.
sam: Kicking a rerun with KV_SHARED=0 now: `/ci rerun nightly-bench 1760894321 --env KV_SHARED=0`
ci-bot: Rerun queued: <https://ci.redwood.com/job/nightly-bench/1760894321-2|#1760894321-2> — will post results.
(some time later)
sam: Rerun completed — cleanup finished and tests passed. Toggling KV_SHARED fixed it. Points to mmap/shared-KV regression.
anya: Nice. Can you bisect the commit range? I suspect the mmap pooling change merged in abc123..def456.
leila: I'll take the bisect. Also opening an infra ticket with logs and rerun artifacts.
sam: Created bug INF-9987 with logs, rerun artifacts, and the flag test: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-9987
anya: Assigning to @leila and marking P1 for nightlies (affects release smoke).
leila: Assigned. Quick mitigation: let's pin the nightly bench image to stable to avoid noisy failures while we debug. I'll also try to reproduce with valgrind/strace to confirm fd/mmap leak.
anya: I'll open a tiny PR to pin the cron config to stable:v2 image.
deploy-bot: Patch applied: crons/nightly-bench pinned -> stable:v2 on staging pools.
leila: If bisect points to mmap pooling I'll write a patch to add a non-shared fallback and a safer unmap sequence.
sam: Thanks everyone. For now marking this resolved — reopen if it recurs.
anya: :thumbsup: resolved for now.
ci-bot: Thread closed by anya at 1760896789
